title: Source
description: One bibliography entry. A fact cites these by id. This is not itself a historical fact.

id.description: Permanent lowercase slug. The filename stem must match.

year.description: Publication year. Negative years are BCE.

doi.description: DOI without a resolver prefix, such as 10.5281/zenodo.0000000.

license.description: License of this work, when it matters (for example GPL-3.0 or CC-BY-4.0).

dataset.description: historical-basemaps sources may be cited only from borders/gpl/. fresh-drawn sources are the provenance required under borders/ccby/.
